name: Mito Health
long_description:
Mito Health is a U.S. service that lets individuals order 12,000+ lab tests, scans, supplements, genetics, home kits, and Rx without a traditional doctor’s visit. Members pay $9 per month to access every product at cost and get itemized receipts with no hidden markups.

The average member saves about $300 a year on a full baseline panel.

What the $9/mth Mito membership gets you:

- 11,000+ practitioner-grade supplements at 35% below Amazon (Thorne, Pure Encapsulations, Life Extension, Ritual, Momentous, Seed)
- 1,200+ lab tests from Quest, Labcorp and BioReference at cost · 49 states · HSA/FSA eligible
- DEXA body composition, bone density, coronary calcium (CAC), whole-body MRI, 30x whole genome sequencing, gut microbiome, multi-cancer early detection
- Every result in one longitudinal record, ordered and reviewed by a partner clinician over concierge
- No markups on tests. No commissions from labs or brands.
- No padded "wellness panels," no upsells, no annual contract; you can cancel anytime.
one_liner: At-cost preventive health: Labs, Scans, Genetics, Supplements and Rx
